scope: Read-only setup audit of commit b1d02b2; no cloud resources or business documents changed

findings: submitBugReport is absent from live functions.
The dedicated cerms-7af24-cerms5-bug-reports bucket returns HTTP 404.
functions/index.mjs imports functions/bug-report.mjs, which is missing; importing the function entry point fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
docs/BUG-REPORTS.md proposes the existing Trigger Email extension. Existing deployment instructions preserve the legacy (default)/mail extension; no compatible CERMS 5 email path is implemented.
required: Implement and test the missing authenticated/idempotent handler.
Use a CERMS 5 email delivery path that does not write to (default) or change the legacy extension; keep credentials server-only.
Provision the isolated private bucket, least-privilege upload/signing access, then deploy only the requested callable after compatibility checks.

findings: cashDrop is absent from live functions.
Local completeSale includes cash-drop-aware register totals, but live completeSale still has the November 16 pre-update timestamp.
Synthetic fixture with cashDropCents=100 and expectedCashCents reduced by 100 is rejected by report-functions/report-render.mjs registerRows with Register cash mismatch.
The current staff function entry point cannot load because the bug-report module is missing.
required: Fix and test daily-report reconciliation for historical totals and cash drops before enabling drops.
Deploy the compatible Dev report update and scoped cashDrop/completeSale updates; preserve all legacy services.

unfinished.feature: Product waivers (zero-price products, not signed membership waivers)
findings: Local rules add optional waiveProducts permission; live rules exactly match the prior notification-sounds release.
Live createStaffAccount, completeSale and sendDevDailyReport timestamps match their recorded deployments before the latest commit.
All Firebase feature configurations still reference the notification-sounds release rather than a new waiver release.
required: Verify waiver permission defaults/denials and receipt/report behavior with synthetic checks.
Archive and deploy the exact named-cerms optional permission rules and scoped createStaffAccount/completeSale/report updates after resolving entry-point and report blockers.

findings: CHANGELOG.md lists bug reports, cash drops and waivers under Unreleased.
required: After backend readiness and end-to-end synthetic verification, package/publish a deliberate desktop release; no release was published during this audit.
